package.author: zekariasasaminew
package.description: Orchestrate multiple AI coding agent CLIs in parallel via git worktrees

en-US.author: zekariasasaminew
en-US.description: Orchestrate multiple AI coding agent CLIs in parallel via git worktrees
en-US.longDescription: pact is a language-agnostic orchestrator for running multiple AI coding agent CLIs (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Codex, Gemini CLI) in parallel on the same git repository, without them fighting each other. Each agent gets its own git worktree for real filesystem isolation, conflicts get detected and surfaced instead of discovered the hard way, and merge-all gets every agent's work back onto one branch automatically wherever it safely can.
en-US.name: pact
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- chore: bump workspace version to 0.4.0 by @zekariasasaminew in #218
- core+vcs: neutralize repo-level merge state around each arbiter attempt, issue #185 by @zekariasasaminew in #220
- cli: pact status, a one-screen repo-wide view, issue #221 by @zekariasasaminew in #223
- cli: spawn-many --dry-run --estimate-cost, issue #222 by @zekariasasaminew in #224
- test: fix 15 integration test cleanup() helpers leaking their .pact- state dir, issue #225 by @zekariasasaminew in #226
- vcs: widen worktree lock timeout from 30s to 30min, issue #230 by @zekariasasaminew in #242
- core+cli: SpawnManyReport, a typed tasks-in-vs-workspaces-out invariant, issue #231 by @zekariasasaminew in #243
- vcs: distinguish a broken gate environment from a failed gate, issue #232 by @zekariasasaminew in #244
- deps: content-store lock patience + --no-deps opt-out, issue #233 by @zekariasasaminew in #245
- vcs+core+cli: --name for spawn/spawn-many, deterministic workspace ids, issue #234 by @zekariasasaminew in #246
- coord: connection visibility + not-yet-created-path conflict detection, issue #235 by @zekariasasaminew in #247
- test: slow-integration tier, fixes a real store_hit race it found, issue #240 by @zekariasasaminew in #248
- vcs+cli: overlap-aware merge risk scoring + tied-score honesty, issue #236 by @zekariasasaminew in #249
- docs+cli: fix SKILL.md grammar drift, add a doc/CLI parity check, issue #238 by @zekariasasaminew in #250
- core: fix negation and brand-name false positives in Weaver, issue #239 by @zekariasasaminew in #251
- agents: sweep the process group after exit, surface a deeper Windows limitation, issue #237 by @zekariasasaminew in #252
- core+agents+cli: Phase progress events and an enriched end-of-run summary, issue #241 by @zekariasasaminew in #254
- Fix Windows agent runs hanging on a grandchild-inherited stdout pipe by @zekariasasaminew in #255
- Fix a race in run_and_stream that could drop an agent's final stdout line by @zekariasasaminew in #257
- Delete the custom npm content store in favor of npm's own global cache by @zekariasasaminew in #258
- Document #185's live re-verification: 4/4 real Arbiter successes by @zekariasasaminew in #259
- Document #203's live re-verification: Copilot routing fix confirmed by @zekariasasaminew in #260
- Add pact init --register-skill to auto-register SKILL.md with agent CLIs by @zekariasasaminew in #261
- Add pact clear-leases: an explicit escape hatch for stale lease persistence by @zekariasasaminew in #262
- Add sentinel-marker union-merge insertion mode by @zekariasasaminew in #263
- Add a typed handoff/negotiation protocol between agents by @zekariasasaminew in #264
- Add an Antigravity (agy) adapter, the real path to Gemini-model access by @zekariasasaminew in #265
- Restructure README around user workflow instead of design decisions by @zekariasasaminew in #266
- Prepare dependencies for merge-all's integration worktree before the gate runs by @zekariasasaminew in #277
- Default workspace slug stops at the first sentence, not a blind character cut by @zekariasasaminew in #278
- README hero: name JSON-aware structural merging, add merge to the problem statement by @zekariasasaminew in #279
- Extend JSON-aware structural merging to Cargo.toml and pyproject.toml dependency tables by @zekariasasaminew in #280
- Add a reproducible regression test for issue #268's N-agent JSON-merge benchmark by @zekariasasaminew in #281
- pact-deps: link mode (junction/symlink node_modules) with safe teardown (#283) by @zekariasasaminew in #289
- pact-agents: lean Copilot launch profile (per-agent COPILOT_HOME, no user MCP servers, deny installs/builds) (#284) by @zekariasasaminew in #292
- pact-cli: absolutize a relative --repo so the worktree lands beside the repo, not inside it (#290) by @zekariasasaminew in #293
- pact-core: memory-aware admission control for spawn-many (--max-concurrent, --min-free-mem-mb, --stagger-ms) (#285) by @zekariasasaminew in #295
- tests: keep pact init --register-skill out of the developer's real COPILOT_HOME (#294) by @zekariasasaminew in #296
- pact-vcs: merge-all --dry-run must not auto-commit dirty workspaces (#286) by @zekariasasaminew in #297
- pact-agents: lean Claude launch profile (--strict-mcp-config, --session-id, tightened allowlist); init 14-19 s -> 6 s (#288) by @zekariasasaminew in #298
- Answer pre-initialize MCP requests instead of exiting (#291) by @zekariasasaminew in #311
- Run doctor version probes without writing to the project (#299) by @zekariasasaminew in #312
- spawn-many --task-file: read worker briefs from files (#307) by @zekariasasaminew in #313
- merge-all --gate each|final: one test run per batch (#309) by @zekariasasaminew in #314
- spawn-many --shared-tree: run every lane in one worktree, no per-lane isolation or merge (#315) by @zekariasasaminew in #316
- Overlap heuristic: carry negation across file lists, skip read-only verbs and member access (#317) by @zekariasasaminew in #319
- Retry PidLock acquire on Windows delete-pending and sharing-violation errors (#318) by @zekariasasaminew in #322
- Reserve memory per running lane in the admission gate (#320) by @zekariasasaminew in #323
- Name each shared-tree lane by its distinguishing task line in the batch commit (#321) by @zekariasasaminew in #324
- Refuse to delete a workspace branch whose commits no other branch reaches (issue #325) by @zekariasasaminew in #326
- Skip shared-tree lanes in detect_conflicts (issue #327) by @zekariasasaminew in #328
- Add pact-acp: minimal Agent Client Protocol client with a blocking per-lane facade (issue #330) by @zekariasasaminew in #334
- Serve pact-coord over Streamable HTTP with one route per lane (issue #329) by @zekariasasaminew in #333
- Add --runtime acp: one shared agent process per agent kind, one ACP session per lane (issue #331) by @zekariasasaminew in #335
- Size the default per-lane memory reserve by lane runtime (issue #332) by @zekariasasaminew in #336
- Default --runtime to auto: acp when every agent in the batch supports it (issue #337) by @zekariasasaminew in #338
- Type ACP updates for suppression and coalesce message chunks (issue #339) by @zekariasasaminew in #340
- Add pact run: plan, brief, execute, commit and verify one task end to end (issue #305) by @zekariasasaminew in #341
- Run repo-declared prepare commands in every new workspace and the integration worktree (issue #301) by @zekariasasaminew in #342
- Let pact run read its task from a file (issue #305) by @zekariasasaminew in #344
- Give the planner effort balance and existing test anchors by @zekariasasaminew in #345
- Move sidecar records into meta/deps and meta/runs by @zekariasasaminew in #346
- Tell the planner workers get the task verbatim and to keep the plan short by @zekariasasaminew in #349
- Log the planner's ACP session and report the planning time by @zekariasasaminew in #350
- Prepare the shared tree and baseline while the planner works by @zekariasasaminew in #354
- Tell the planner a brief is two or three sentences, not a file summary by @zekariasasaminew in #355
- Size pact run's unit count and concurrency from the machine by @zekariasasaminew in #357
- Stamp ACP lane and planner log lines with the wall-clock by @zekariasasaminew in #359
- Make pact run's verify a list of commands with a verdict each by @zekariasasaminew in #363
- Hand the project-wide checks to pact; workers verify their own files by @zekariasasaminew in #364
- Repair a failed combined verification with one more lane (#362) by @zekariasasaminew in #365
- Cut README to a short front page; move the reference and history out (#367) by @zekariasasaminew in #370
- Rewrite SKILL.md, GETTING_STARTED and the agent instruction files for pact run (#368) by @zekariasasaminew in #375
- Mark pact as experimental and not actively developed (#376) by @zekariasasaminew in #377
